caption: The drawing depicts a pair of connected, tan-colored ceramic jugs with a shared vertical seam in the center and individual rounded necks and openings at the top. The surface of the jugs is speckled with darker brown spots. Each jug is decorated with blue line drawings; the left jug features a fish with an open mouth, bubbles, and the words "NEW-HAVEN" written multiple times, while the right jug displays a bird standing on a braided or knotted motif, also with bubbles, and the repeated inscription "NEW-HAVEN." The two jugs are joined by a vertical, upward extension of clay between their necks. The artist's signature "YOLANDE DELASSER" is in the lower right corner of the image. The background is a plain light beige with some faint pencil guidelines and smudges visible.
title: Gemel Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
